description.value: Elmo Baking Co. is an artisan bakery in Port Moody founded by a pastry chef with nearly two decades of experience at Vancouver institutions including Thomas Haas and the Four Seasons Hotel. The shop is known for its signature twice-baked croissants, meticulously handcrafted 33-layer viennoiseries, and desserts with bold flavours influenced by Asian heritage. It sits along Brewery Row just down the road from Rocky Point Park, making it a natural mid-ride treat stop for cyclists exploring the Burrard Inlet waterfront.
